blurb: Guests explore a recreated 19th-century seaport village, historic wooden vessels, and maritime exhibitions. They can take captained river cruises or self-navigate rowboats, sailboats, and pedal boats on the Mystic River. The museum offers seasonal programming, special events, and group tours.
